title: 第16章 他背后的老板，和安怜的关系，不一般
novel_title: 贵族学院平民盲女怎么成了白月光
content_zh:
楼下传来大门关上的声音，安怜这才彻底放松下来，长长地呼出一口气。

    她真的好累。

    腰酸，腿软，浑身上下没有一处不酸痛的。

    她闭上眼睛，想着等会儿吃完午餐就回宿舍，好好睡一觉。

    想着想着，她又想到了月影回廊的事。

    叶闻白真的好细心，这让她对他的负罪感又重了几分。

    安怜叹了口气，把脸埋进枕头里，不想再去想这些烦心事。

    她在床上又躺了一会儿，等体力恢复了一些，才慢慢爬起来，去卫生间洗漱换衣服。

    出来时，客厅的桌上已经摆好了午餐。

    管家恭敬地站在一旁，听到安怜出来的声音，说道：“安怜小姐，午餐已经准备好了，少爷特意吩咐让您多吃一点。”

    安怜点头：“谢谢。”

    她坐到餐桌前，慢慢吃起来。

    午餐很丰盛，都是她喜欢的菜，安怜吃得很满足。

    吃完饭，她又休息了一会儿，才离开叶闻白的别墅。

    回宿舍的路上，她走的还是一条最偏僻的小路。

    这条小路穿过学院后山的一片小树林，平时很少有人经过。

    安怜走得很慢，因为腰实在酸得厉害，每走一步都十分吃力。

    她在心里把叶闻白骂了一百八十遍，顺便把江彻也骂了一百遍。

    这两个人，一个比一个过分。

    好不容易走到宿舍楼下，安怜正准备上楼，一道陌生的声音叫住了她。

    “安怜小姐。”

    安怜停下脚步，转过身，朝着声音的方向看去。

    “请问你是？”安怜问。

    “我是江总的助理，免贵姓林。”男人说，“江总今天有个很重要的会议，实在抽不开身，所以特意吩咐我过来。”

    安怜愣了一下。

    江彻的助理？

    什么事那么重要，值得特意让助理跑一趟？

    “江总听说月影回廊要开了，”林助理继续道，“他知道您封印课成绩一直不太好，所以提前帮您打点好了去月影回廊的事宜。”

    安怜：“……？”

    又是月影回廊？

    林助理：“江总说，他已经安排好了专人带您去入口，您在月影回廊里面的一切需求，都会有人替您解决。”

    安怜张了张嘴，想说不用了，但林助理没给她机会。

    “另外，江总还让我带了一些东西给您。”

    “这是江总特意让人从北境城带回来的保暖衣物，月影回廊里面温度低，得多穿点。”
content_en:
The sound of the door closing was heard from downstairs, and An Lian completely relaxed and took a long breath.

    She is really tired.

    My waist is sore, my legs are weak, and there is no part of my body that is not aching.

    She closed her eyes, thinking about going back to the dormitory after lunch and having a good sleep.

    As she thought about it, she thought about the Moon Shadow Corridor again.

    Ye Wenbai was really attentive, which made her feel even more guilty about him.

    An Lian sighed and buried her face in the pillow, not wanting to think about these troublesome things anymore.

    She lay on the bed for a while, waiting for her strength to recover before slowly getting up and going to the bathroom to wash up and change clothes.

    When I came out, lunch was already placed on the table in the living room.

    The housekeeper stood respectfully and heard An Lian's voice coming out and said, "Miss An Lian, lunch is ready. The young master specifically asked you to eat more."

    An Lian nodded: "Thank you."

    She sat down at the dining table and ate slowly.

    The lunch was very sumptuous, all her favorite dishes, and An Lian was very satisfied with the meal.

    After eating, she rested for a while before leaving Ye Wenbai's villa.

    On the way back to the dormitory, she took the most remote path.

    This path passes through a small forest on the mountain behind the college, and few people usually pass by it.

    An Lian walked slowly because her waist was so sore that every step she took was very laborious.

    She scolded Ye Wenbai a hundred and eighty times in her heart, and also scolded Jiang Che a hundred times.

    These two people, one is more extreme than the other.

    After finally reaching the downstairs of the dormitory, An Lian was about to go upstairs when a strange voice stopped her.

    "Miss An Lian."

    An Lian stopped, turned around, and looked in the direction of the sound.

    "Excuse me, who are you?" An Lian asked.

    "I am Mr. Jiang's assistant, so my surname is Lin." The man said, "Mr. Jiang has a very important meeting today and I really can't get away, so I specially asked me to come here."

    An Lian was stunned for a moment.

    Jiang Che's assistant?

    What is so important that it deserves an assistant’s special trip?

    "Mr. Jiang heard that the Moon Shadow Corridor is about to open," Assistant Lin continued, "He knows that your sealing class performance has not been very good, so he helped you make arrangements to go to the Moon Shadow Corridor in advance."

    An Lian: "...?"

    Moon Shadow Corridor again?

    Assistant Lin: "Mr. Jiang said that he has arranged for someone to take you to the entrance. Someone will take care of all your needs in the Moon Shadow Corridor."

    An Lian opened her mouth and wanted to say no, but Assistant Lin didn't give her a chance.

    "In addition, Mr. Jiang asked me to bring you some things."

    "These are warm clothes that Mr. Jiang specially brought back from Beijing City. The temperature inside the Moon Shadow Corridor is low, so wear more clothes."
title_en: Chapter 16 The boss behind him has an unusual relationship with An Lian
